thread:
maya: kicking off an AWQ group-size + act-quant sweep on redwood-mini-7b for a canary in us-west — watching stability and accuracy deltas
cheng: noted. what ranges and seeds are you running?
maya: groups = [8, 16, 32], act_quant = [on, off], seed = 42. baseline is GPTQ fp16 fallback. collecting ppl, exact-match, and latency profiles
dmitri: please capture kernel fallback counters and kv-cache warnings. last time group=32 caused mem thrash and stalls
infra-bot: Deploy started: canary redwood-mini-7b @ canary-3 (deploy id d-7649)
maya: quick 10m perf snapshot:
group8 act=on: p50 68ms, p95 210ms, throughput ~18 rps
group16 act=on: p50 71ms, p95 260ms, throughput ~16 rps
group32 act=on: p50 73ms, p95 420ms, intermittent spikes and increased tail latency
eva: accuracy on eval-suite-A (20 prompts): group8 act=on delta vs baseline -0.3% absolute; group16 act=on -0.9%; group32 act=on -1.7% (regression concentrated on codegen prompts)
maya: weird: group16 act=off showed tokenization drift on prompt #12 (short tokens duplicated)
cheng: can you paste any kv/allocator warnings from the runner logs?
maya: logs:
```
WARN kv_cache: prealloc mismatch requested=1.2GB available=768MB
WARN runner: batch_size 32 collapsed to 8 due to mem hardlimit
ERROR decode: stream stalled waiting for kv shards
```
dmitri: explains the p95 spikes — mem thrash caused the scheduler to fallback to single-threaded decode; KV prealloc mismatch is the smoking gun
maria: quick mitigation idea: try act-quant only on MLP layers (skip attention) to reduce activation memory blowup; also try quant-algorithm variant awq-v2-lite
prod-eng: saw two "stream disconnect" incidents correlated with group32 runs in the last 12m, marking incident ticket INC-983
maya: rolling canary back from group32 immediately. keeping group8 and group16 to run longer evals
eva: plan: run 1h A/B between group8 act=on and baseline, capture ppl, exact-match, 5-shot codegen, and token disfluency metrics. will also run prompt subset that triggered drift
cheng: add kernel tracer and allocator snapshot: /ops/kernel-trace?range=canary-3 and /ops/allocator-dump
maya: ack — running extended canary, dropping logs here once complete
infra-bot: Deploy ended: canary redwood-mini-7b @ canary-3 (deploy id d-7649). status: partial (group32 rolled back)
maya: next steps: deep diffs for group8/16 vs baseline, q-error heatmap, and if drift >1.0% plan rollback. also schedule a GPU mem profiling run to tune prealloc thresholds
cheng: if group8 looks stable, we can try act-quant selective patching (MLP only) on a tiny canary before full rollout
maya: thanks — keeping thread updated with artifacts and eval CSVs :thumbsup:
